protocol.scope: three legacy assets, retained snapshots only; 45 fields; no new bake or quality
protocol.ao_arc_sampling: equal-length strata centers on stable edge-ID order
protocol.ao_ray_sequence: NumPy default_rng seed17; shared local cosine directions for equal sample indices
protocol.ao_reference: all original physical mesh edges; same reference cached per exact geometry hash
protocol.ao_primary_scope: explicit state.seams, physical edges counted once; empty set is N/A
protocol.ao_additional_scope: explicit seams UNION original one-face boundary edges, counted once
protocol.ao_distance_reason: covers entire finite mesh from a surface-origin sample, not A.3 local .3d attribute
protocol.ao_edge_normal: mean unit incident face normals, normalized; first incident normal if cancellation
protocol.ao_hit_test: existing ReSeam NumPy BVH, two-sided triangles; no geometry repair
protocol.non_disk: per-chart Euler V-E+F != 1 on actual UV vertex identities
protocol.chart_shape: sum absolute triangle UV areas; topological boundary length; arithmetic mean over charts
protocol.jaggedness_aggregation: all resampled boundary-point second differences pooled; raw UV units
protocol.jaggedness_unpublished_scale: no multiplier to force agreement with paper Table1 values
protocol.invalid_boundaries: skip non-cycle boundary components and report counts; no quality upgrade
protocol.distortion: reuse frozen baseline.report.distortion_metrics; angular orthogonality added per A.6
protocol.original_reference: different original geometry; no cross-geometry color or timing imputation
protocol.project_choices: formula-based project implementation; official evaluation code was not available
fields: 输入／目标贴图边长 px
排布覆盖率／原始覆盖率 ↑
原生／最终单位方格覆盖 ↑
总面积口径密度 px/模型单位
边界二阶差分采样点数
记录3D切缝长度 ↓（原表“新增”口径）
记录切缝长／表面积 ↓（原表口径）
protocol.new_seam_scope: existing state.seams measured from uncut mesh, NOT net addition relative to authored UV
protocol.absent_low_uv: geometry counts and source image size only; UV quantities remain N/A
protocol.failed_pack_scope: measure retained native UV; coverage final and color errors remain unavailable
protocol.ranking: none across geometry variants or failed quality; raw metrics remain visible
